summary: PR #261 (CASSSIDECAR-347) caches the merged metrics map in FilteringMetricRegistry.getMetrics() in a volatile field and invalidates it on register(), remove() and the excluded-metric creation path. It also precomputes the hashCode in PeriodicTaskKey. I read the whole diff (medium tier) and applied conditions-and-predicates first, then logic.md and boundary.md, plus the sidecar cass-logic-boundary lens notes. The invalidation in register() and remove() happens after the mutation, so those paths are correct. The excluded-metric path invalidates before the mutation, which can leave a stale cached map (one finding). The PeriodicTaskKey hashCode precompute is behavior-equivalent because the identifier is final. Not reviewed: the new test file FilteringMetricRegistryTest.java and CHANGES.txt (other lenses own them). Nothing else skipped.

findings.title: Invalidate cached allMetrics after the excluded metric is inserted, not before
findings.rule: Derived cache invalidated before its source is updated (logic checklist 30; conditions and predicates)
findings.problem: addExcludedMetricIfNotExists sets allMetrics = null inside the computeIfAbsent mapping function, which runs before ConcurrentHashMap inserts the new entry. Trigger: thread A calls counter("excluded.x") for the first time and nulls the cache. Before A's computeIfAbsent returns, thread B calls getMetrics(), rebuilds the snapshot from excludedMetrics (which does not yet contain the entry) and stores it in allMetrics. A then inserts the entry and nothing invalidates again. getMetrics() keeps returning a map without the excluded metric until some unrelated register() or remove() happens. That defeats the documented purpose of getMetrics(), which is to include excluded metrics so they are not re-registered. register() is not affected because it invalidates again after registerInternal returns; the counter/histogram/meter/timer/gauge paths are.
findings.fix: Invalidate after the insert. Call excludedMetrics.computeIfAbsent(...) first, and when it newly added the entry, set allMetrics = null after it returns. For example, record a flag in the mapping lambda, then invalidate once computeIfAbsent has returned. This also removes the synchronized block from inside the CHM mapping function.
